The concept is fantastic, it's a really great idea but needs some more time in the oven. There are lots of buttons that are explained poorly and the entire game is far too RNG-based to reward any strategy. I was coming into this as a massive Balatro lover, and unfortunately this game doesn't have the same ability to encourage replay-ability. The RNG is far too unforgiving and the strategies you can implement are limited. Again, I love the concept, but in it's current state I don't think I can recommend this game yet. I think if the developer spent some time on refining the gameplay loop and giving the player more to do while punishing them less, it would be a lot more enjoyable.

The echo of Balatro will echo through games for a decade, people desperate to figure out the sauce for a game where random object generation combines with escalating stakes to give you a tense high that feels compelling. And the concept here, a calculator, is hilarious. I've been checking in with each update, and I think after all this time I've simply come to the conclusion that there isn't the sauce here. It's a fun idea, but doesn't have much more than that to work with. I don't think more updates are going to improve that.
